'''Sun-dried tomatoes''' are the preservation of [[tomatoes]]. They heal {{Hp|6}} and grant {{EffectLink|Strength}} for 5 minutes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/pickled_tomatoes.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
Raw tomatoes, a brown mushroom and a glass bottle. Picking up tomatoes unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating sun-dried tomatoes takes 1.6 seconds, heals {{Hp|6}} and gives Strength I for 5:00. It gives the glass bottle back when eaten.

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.6-alpha|Pickled tomatoes renamed to sun-dried tomatoes.}}
